question.text: Equal volumes of 0.1 M NaCl and 0.06 M <math><mtext>CaC</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> solutions are separated by a semi- permeable membrane in container. For this system, choose the correct answer

options.text: Water flows from NaCl solution towards <math><mtext>CaC</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> solution
There is no movement of any solution across the membrane
Osmotic pressure of 0.1 M NaCl is lower than the osmotic pressure of <math><mtext>CaC</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> (Assume complete dissociation)
Water flows form <math><mtext>CaC</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> solution towards NaCl solution

solution.text:
Using πV=iCRT
i = 2 for NaCl
i = 3 for CaCl2
πVNaCl=2×0.1RT=0.2RT
πVCaCl2=3×0.06RT=0.18RT
As πVNaCl>πVCaCl2 .
Here water flows from CaCl2 towards NaCl solution.
